# Identity Digital
> Identity Digital provides domain registry, registrar, and reseller services for creating and managing digital identities across a large domain portfolio.

Identity Digital serves businesses, governments, nonprofits, individuals, and channel partners with domain infrastructure, portfolio access, and technology services. This file highlights the main public sections of nic.direct and key partner-oriented pages.

## Main
- [Home](https://nic.direct/): Overview of Identity Digital’s domain portfolio, services, and partner offerings.
- [Registrar](https://nic.direct/registrar): Information for registrars on domain access, services, and partnership opportunities.
- [Registry](https://nic.direct/registry): Overview of registry services, infrastructure, and domain extension management.
- [Reseller](https://nic.direct/reseller): Details on reseller solutions for offering domains and related services.
- [Company](https://nic.direct/company): Corporate information, mission, and background on Identity Digital.
- [Contact](https://nic.direct/contact): Contact options for inquiries about services, partnerships, and support.

## Partner Solutions
- [Registrar](https://nic.direct/registrar): Registrar-focused solutions for domain distribution and customer service enablement.
- [Registry](https://nic.direct/registry): Registry operator services for launching and managing domain extensions.
- [Reseller](https://nic.direct/reseller): Reseller program information for partners expanding domain offerings.
- [Contact](https://nic.direct/contact): Reach the team for partnership, product, or service discussions.

## Company
- [Company](https://nic.direct/company): Learn about the company’s role in digital identity and domain infrastructure.
- [Careers](https://nic.direct/careers): Explore open roles and employment opportunities at Identity Digital.
- [Newsroom](https://nic.direct/newsroom): Company announcements, press releases, and media updates.
- [Contact](https://nic.direct/contact): General company contact information and inquiry channels.
